Source.Name: perl-xml-libxslt
Source.Summary: XML::LibXSLT - Interface to the GNOME libxslt library
Source.Description: This module is an interface to the GNOME project's libxslt. This is an extremely good XSLT engine, highly compliant and also very fast. I have tests showing this to be more than twice as fast as Sablotron.
